# mktemp

Create unique temporary paths for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/mktemp@0.1.5 [OPTION]... [TEMPLATE]
```

## Supported scope

Create a file or directory without overwriting existing entries. The final X run in a template must contain at least three characters.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-d` / `--directory` | none | create a directory |
| `-q` / `--quiet` | none | suppress creation and output errors |
| `-p` / `--tmpdir` | required | use DIR, then TMPDIR, then /tmp |
| `--suffix` | required | append SUFFIX to a template ending in X |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `-t` | none | use DIR, then TMPDIR, then /tmp |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Unsafe -u dry runs are unsupported. Suffixes cannot contain directory separators.
- Without a destination, the default uses TMPDIR or /tmp; that directory must exist.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/mktemp@0.1.5 -p . sample.XXXXXX
moonx cli/mktemp@0.1.5 -d -p . sample.XXXXXX
```
